items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: I caught Coleman in person for the first time at Dave's Cafe... he was very nice to me and so he says, 'Come on, let's go outside,' So we went outside

ctx.x: Then when Coleman Hawkins came back from Europe and he did "Body and Soul" and with that subdued...and so I said, "There's another dimension." But it was heavy and deep and that meant that you had to have control. So then I started learning my breathing exercises and I became aware of my health, really, 'cause I was an athelete. But I really became aware of my health, which you have to go through, then finally when I heard Ben Webster...Ben Webster came to Lansing, Michigan, with Duke Ellington's Band and I heard…

Jimmy Rochelle. So we come to Chicago, on a holiday, and I caught Coleman in person for the first time at Dave's Cafe which was at 55th and Garfield. And I heard that sound. Now, what actually I heard was that every note that he played...they were all the same bigness, all the notes. I says, "Ohhhh, ohhhhh," because the other tenor players, they had certain notes that they petted and they became bigger, but all of his notes were big. And it was really somethin'. When they do the show he came out from the kitchen…
